page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 4 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators present on this instance, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The CPU configuration lacks advanced instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA_NI). This absence of specialized vector and matrix instructions limits its efficiency for workloads involving heavy mathematical modeling, machine learning inference, or intensive cryptographic operations.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is structured for compute-focused tasks that do not require large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This profile is suitable for basic web serving, lightweight application servers, batch processing, and utility workloads that require predictable CPU execution but have modest memory and storage demands.
